value: 37 of the 90 strongly responding antennal olfactory sensory neurons (A cells) responded best to the aggregation pheromone lineatin
method: single-sensillum recordings from antennal club sensilla with a 57-compound odour panel at 10 ug per stimulus, followed by dose-response series
conditions: adults field-collected April to June 2020 and 2021 with lineatin-baited funnel traps in two conifer forests in southern Sweden, so the beetles had been drawn to the compound being tested; beetles fixed in wax, compounds screened in random order, a 10 uL paraffin oil blank once per sensillum and any oil response subtracted from the net response; 'strongly responding' is defined in the Table 1 caption as 80 Hz or more to one or several compounds at the 10 ug dose, and responses under 20 Hz at the screening dose count as no response; Methods say 187 sensilla were contacted using 48 male and 64 female beetles whereas the Abstract and Results say 170 sensilla, and the paper does not reconcile the two; thirteen OSN classes were found, most in both sexes (classes 5, 8 and 11 only in males, class 7 only in females); the lineatin class held 22 female and 15 male neurons by Table 1 and the text does not test a sex difference; the next Results sentence says 28 of the lineatin-responsive neurons also responded to other compounds, generally more weakly; the dose-response series (10 pg to 10 ug, 8 neurons) gave a threshold near 10 pg and used racemic (+/-)-lineatin; the quote counts the best-responding class, not a response threshold

value: antennal olfactory sensory neuron class IAc6 showed high specificity (>80 Hz) to alpha-isophorone (n = 6)
method: single-sensillum recordings from antennal sensilla of Ips acuminatus with a screening panel at 10 ug per stimulus, followed by dose-response series
conditions: the preceding Results sentence says IAc6 was the most abundant OSN class in this species and was found exclusively in females (n = 7), so the n = 7 and n = 6 of the two sentences are not reconciled in the text; beetles were reared from infested Scots pine branches collected in spring 2024 near Rouchovany (Czech Republic) plus a second batch from naturally infested pine in northeastern Austria reared in Vienna and sent to Lund, so origin is wild-derived and two-site; sexed by elytral spines; spike counts over the first 0.5 s corrected for baseline and the paraffin oil control; under 20 Hz at the screening dose counted as no response, 40 to 60 Hz intermediate, above 80 Hz strong; compounds screened in random order, dose series in increasing concentration from 10 pg to 10 ug; the tool summary says IAc6 neurons did not respond to verbenone or other panel compounds and had a threshold near 10 pg, which is not in the quote and is not carried in the value; 82 sensilla of I. acuminatus (85 of I. cembrae) were contacted and nineteen OSN classes were identified across the two species; this record is for I. acuminatus only
